title: 30-layer HfO2/SiO2 dichroic with thickness bounds centered on Round 1 best candidate
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining layer thicknesses to ±35% of the Round 1 best candidate values will prevent optimizer drift into non-productive regions while allowing sufficient freedom to improve the dichroic figure of merit toward the theoretical limit.
design_principle: Bounded local optimization around a known high-performing configuration preserves the interference physics that achieved 0.9532 score while enabling fine-tuning.
proposed_topology: exactly 6 alternating HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers)
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds ensure manufacturability near Round 1 solution
theory_basis: Transfer-matrix method for layered isotropic media
Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflection bands
expected_advantages: Prevents optimizer from exploring thickness regions that degraded Round 5 performance
known_risks: Bounds may prevent discovery of superior non-local optima
Round 1 candidate may already be near local optimum
execution_request_english: Optimize a 30-layer dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: alternating HfO2 and SiO2, starting with HfO2 at air interface (30 finite layers total, 15 pairs). Initialize thicknesses at [59.0, 95.0, 64.0, 91.0, 100.0, 131.0, 57.0, 98.0, 96.0, 91.0, 61.0, 90.0, 56.0, 77.0, 55.0, 71.0, 51.0, 86.0, 99.0, 93.0, 78.0, 127.0, 77.0, 71.0, 42.0, 52.0, 73.0, 87.0, 49.0, 115.0] nm. Constrain each layer thickness to ±35% of its initialization value. Optimize for maximum transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band and maximum reflectance in 400-700 nm band under normal incidence, unpolarized illumination. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with bounded variables. Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 6 alternating HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1530–1565 nm; high reflection in 400–700 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1530–1565 nm; transmission in 400–700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 30.
revision_reason: Round 5 reduced layer count from 30 to 12, causing score regression from 0.9532 to 0.8391. This route restores 30 layers and adds thickness bounds centered on Round 1 best candidate to prevent optimizer drift while preserving the interference capacity that achieved higher performance.
